pairs.difference: A: the motel sign boards are soft, rounded slabs with a smooth matte finish. The posts and the house are simplified, with no surface grain. B: the brick wall has a crisp per-brick mortar pattern with fine surface noise. The steel wall bracket is drawn as hardware, with a flat plate, visible bolt heads, a diagonal strut and a ball-end rod. The sign rim is a sharp polished-metal ring.
pairs.fix: Make the wall bracket one smooth, thick rounded bar with no bolts or plate screws. Paint the bricks as soft, large rounded blocks with quiet mortar and no gritty surface noise. Give the sign rim a soft satin finish.

pairs.difference: A: the fedora felt has a very fine, quiet nap. The band is matte. The overall look is soft, like the real cards. B: the jacket is smooth matte clay with crisp pocket-flap edges and small chrome snaps. The sash badges are glossy enamel coins with their own rims. That is a mix of many small, separately finished parts, and the micro texture sits at the top of the real range.
pairs.fix: Show fewer, larger badge shapes with a soft satin finish. Drop the metal snaps. Make the jacket fabric one soft cloth surface with broad, simple folds.

pairs.difference: A: the lion and plinth are glossy polished marble with thin grey crack veins drawn over the plinth faces and the body. The hair locks are finely carved and sharp-edged. B: the caravan has smooth matte panels, soft rounded trim and simple broad hardware, which matches the real caravan card in the anchor.
pairs.fix: Paint the stone as soft matte cream stone with no vein lines. Group the mane into a few broad, smooth locks.

pairs.difference: A: the radio's wood has strong, decorative flowing grain lines over the whole cabinet. The speaker cloth shows a visible woven texture. The brass knobs and dial frame are mirror-polished. The tabletop has a lacquered reflection, so gloss is above the real range. B: the rocking chair's wood has broad, soft streaks and a matte-satin finish. The cushion is smooth.
pairs.fix: Paint the wood cabinet with only a few faint, quiet grain streaks and a satin finish. Make the speaker cloth a smooth, flat beige panel. Use soft, broad highlights on the knobs instead of mirror reflections.

pairs.difference: A: the popcorn cart has soft, matte painted wood and metal, simple rounded wheels, and gentle highlights on the glass. B: the folding camera has a hard black finish with crisp chrome edging and a reflector dish with fine radial brushed-metal lines. A metal strut and screw feet sit on a glossy wood table with fine grain. Gloss and micro texture are both above the real range.
pairs.fix: Replace the radial brushed lines in the reflector dish with one smooth, soft silver gradient. Make the camera body soft satin black with a few broad highlights. Make the tabletop matte with faint grain.

pairs.difference: A: the briefcase leather has a fine pebbled grain all over. Thin dashed white stitching runs along the flap edge. The gold clasps and handle rings are small, separately finished metal parts. Real cards like the anchor suitcase show smooth leather with no stitch dashes. B: the vending machine is smooth glossy blue plastic, with tiny condensation droplets and some soft blur on the glass.
pairs.fix: Make the leather smooth and soft with no pebble grain. Remove the dashed stitch lines along the flap. Draw the clasps as two simple, broad rounded gold blocks.

pairs.difference: A: the bus has a soft painted red body, softened windows and only light speckle on the road. B: the taxi body is uniformly lacquered yellow. The road shows dense fine grain noise across the whole asphalt, and the trim is crisp. Micro texture and detail are well above the real range.
pairs.fix: Paint the road as a smooth, soft grey surface with no gritty noise. Give the car body a satin finish with one broad soft highlight.

pairs.difference: A: the shield's gold face carries fine brushed scratch and noise texture across its whole surface, plus a hot glossy glare in the top-left corner. The silver rim is chrome-bright. B: the ring box is soft matte velvet. The coin is a smooth gold disc with broad, clean highlights.
pairs.fix: Make the gold shield face a smooth, clean surface with no scratch or noise texture. Use one soft, broad highlight and a satin silver rim.

pairs.difference: A: the blue door has visible, decorative wood-grain streaks painted over every panel. The frame has more grain. The ivy and the wreath are dozens of small, glossy, separately lit leaves and petals. Gloss share is 0.51, far above real. B: the wood door and brick have broad, simple blocks. The hinges are simple brass, and the finish is fairly matte.
pairs.fix: Paint the door as a smooth, flat-colored blue surface with no wood grain. Make the leaves and flowers fewer, larger and matte, with soft simple shading.

pairs.difference: A: the fingerprint ridges are smudgy ink strokes with ragged, grainy edges. The ink pad has a fuzzy noise texture. The tin has a crisp brushed-metal rim. The table shows strong, glossy dark wood grain. Detail, micro texture and gloss are all far above the real range. B: the map, the magnifier and the table are clean and soft, with broad, simple shapes.
pairs.fix: Draw the fingerprint as clean, smooth, evenly thick dark lines. Make the ink pad a flat, soft black surface. Paint the tabletop matte with faint, quiet grain.

pairs.difference: A: the magnifier has a smooth satin-silver rim, clean glass with one curved highlight stroke and a soft red handle. B: the hoop is a clean white matte backboard with a smooth red frame and simple cord netting. Both are smooth, simplified finishes in line with the real cards. B's high highlight share comes from the white board color, not from gloss.

A: the popsicle is covered in fine speckle noise. Frosty crystal crusts sit at its edges, along with many glassy droplets. This is a dense micro texture that no real card shows. B: the fruit plate also has droplets and seed detail, but the fruit surfaces are smoother and the wood grain is broad.
pairs.fix: Paint the popsicle as smooth, soft pink ice with no speckles or frost crust. Use at most one or two simple droplets and one broad soft highlight.

pattern: Generated cards add fine surface detail that real cards leave out, such as dashed stitch lines, bolts and brackets, brushed or radial metal lines and gritty asphalt or brick noise. They also add strong decorative wood grain, marble veins, frost speckles and condensation droplets, and they apply glossy lacquer everywhere. Real cards keep surfaces soft and smooth, with mostly matte or satin finishes. They show wood grain only as faint, broad streaks and draw hardware as a few broad rounded parts.
